Do I need to be a CS major to join?

Nope, anyone can join! We welcome all majors and experience levels.

When and where are meetings?

We meet on Thursdays at 7 PM in ISC 2280.

What about office hours?

Our office hours are Mon-Fri 9-11 AM and 2-4 PM, and Mon-Thurs 6-7 PM in ISC 2394

How do I get updates?

You can use the Connect page to join GroupMe or follow socials.

What kinds of events does ACM run?

During our weekly meetings, we have workshops, speaker talks, collaborations, and social events.
We also host special events like the CS brunch and annual CS banquet, and we provide transportation to hackathons.

Can I suggest an event or give a workshop?

Yes! You can message an officer on GroupMe or Discord, come by our office hours, or stay after our weekly meetings.
